theme.designMd:
# Portfolio Scrollytelling Design System

Polished, professional dark UI. Calm reveals, restrained motion, content first.
Carries over the current site look: slate background, emerald accent.

## Colors
| Role | Hex |
|---|---|
| Background | #0F172A (slate-900) |
| Background deep | #020617 (slate-950) |
| Surface / card | #1E293B (slate-800) |
| Border | #334155 (slate-700) |
| Text | #F1F5F9 |
| Muted text | #CBD5E1 |
| Accent (emerald) | #34D399 -> #059669 gradient, used for highlighted words and the active progress dot |

## Typography
Inter. H1 56px/1.2, H2 32px/1.3, body 18px/1.6, labels 12px uppercase tracking-wide. Highlighted words (`<b>`) use the emerald gradient.

## Shape and spacing
Radius 12px. 8px spacing grid. Thin 1px borders, soft shadows, no glows.

## Layout and motion
- Desktop: two columns. Text steps scroll on the left, the visual stays pinned on the right (sticky, 100svh).
- Mobile: stacked, no pinning, visual sits inline above each step.
- Slim progress rail on the right edge: one dot per chapter, active dot is emerald, labels on hover. Becomes a top progress bar on mobile.
- Starfield particles stay as the fixed backdrop.
- Motion: fades and small translates under 0.5s; inactive steps at 25% opacity. All motion off under prefers-reduced-motion.

## Chapters
1. Hello: name, role, tagline.
2. Person: hobbies (video games, camping, kayaking) and mentoring. Photos on the sticky panel.
3. Career: pinned timeline. Each step swaps the sticky card (company, role, period, stack).
4. Skills + AI: steps through Frontend, Backend, Cloud and DevOps, Testing, then "How I work with AI". Sticky panel shows tech logos, then an AI workflow diagram.
5. Contact: links and CV downloads.

screens.prompt:
Desktop closing chapter 'Contact' for a polished scrollytelling portfolio website.
Aesthetic & Theme: Dark theme with slate-950/slate-900 backgrounds, subtle glowing radial ambient emerald gradients (#34D399), clean modern sans-serif typography, crisp borders (slate-800/slate-700), and elegant spacing.

Components & Layout:
1. Top Header: Include the TopNavBar with brand title 'Portfolio', navigation links ('Hello', 'Person', 'Career', 'Skills & AI', 'Contact'), with 'Contact' styled as the active chapter.
2. Side Progress Rail / Navigation: On the right side, the 5-step progress rail corresponding to the chapters ('Hello', 'Person', 'Career', 'Skills & AI', 'Contact'). The 5th/last dot is active (emerald glowing accent), while dots 1-4 are completed/inactive.
3. Hero / Contact Centerpiece:
   - Subtle chapter eyebrow badge: '05 / CLOSING CHAPTER' or 'GET IN TOUCH' with an emerald dot indicator.
   - Prominent centered headline: 'Let's talk'.
   - Supporting subtext: 'Have a project in mind, an opportunity, or just want to chat tech & design? I’m always open to new conversations.'
   - Primary direct contact card / actions:
     - Prominent Email action button (e.g. 'hello@developer.io' or 'Send an Email' with copy-to-clipboard or mailto trigger indicator).
     - Social & Profile link buttons: LinkedIn button with icon, GitHub button with icon.
   - Dedicated CV / Resume Section:
     - Section label or header: 'Curriculum Vitae'.
     - Two distinct CV download action cards/buttons:
       - 'Download CV (English)' with PDF badge, file size indicator (e.g., 'PDF • 1.2 MB'), and download icon.
       - 'Download CV (Dutch / Nederlands)' with PDF badge, file size indicator (e.g., 'PDF • 1.2 MB'), and download icon.
   - Quick status tag: 'Currently available for freelance & full-time roles' with a pulsing emerald status beacon.
4. Footer: Clean scrollytelling footer with copyright, back-to-top scrolly trigger, and closing credits.
screens.title: Contact - Let's talk

outputComponents.text:
Here is the closing chapter **"Contact"** screen designed for your desktop scrollytelling portfolio:

### Key Highlights & Design Decisions:
- **Hero & Title**: Features an ambient glowing dark background with the centered heading **"Let's build something exceptional together"** / **"Let's talk"** aesthetic, paired with an availability status badge showing current openness to freelance & full-time roles.
- **Direct Contact & Social Links**:
  - **Email Card**: Direct action to write (`hello@developer.io`) alongside a quick "Copy address" trigger and response time guarantee.
  - **Social & Code**: Sleek link cards for **LinkedIn** (networking & recommendations) and **GitHub** (repositories & open source).
- **Dual-Language CV Downloads**:
  - Dedicated document cards for **English** and **Dutch (Nederlands)** with file type badges (`PDF • 1.2 MB • v2025.1`) and download triggers.
- **Scrollytelling Progress Rail**: Right-side vertical progression rail tracking all 5 narrative chapters, with the **5th and final dot ("05 / 05 Contact") active and highlighted in emerald**.
- **Navigation & Footer**: Cohesive top bar and footer with quick jump triggers ("Back to start", "Previous: Skills & AI").

outputComponents.suggestion: Add an interactive contact inquiry form modal
Include a calendar booking widget (e.g., Cal.com / Calendly)
Generate a mobile responsive layout for this screen
